evidence_quotes: Uitleg artikelen Warmtewet is een te zeer algemeen belang
Uitleg artikel 66f Gaswet en artikel 10, zesde lid, Gaswet, aansluitplicht
rationale: This Dutch CBb decision (ECLI:NL:CBB:2016:243) concerns third-party standing and the interpretation of gas and heat network regulation under the Gaswet (articles 66f and 10(6), connection obligation/aansluitplicht and supplier choice) and the Warmtewet, rather than water law, water governance, or water/sanitation utility services. Per the coding protocol, gas and heat network aansluitplicht disputes are classified as NOT_WATER and not_water_related.
